head: Systemic Non-Selective Herbicide for Total Weed Control
desc: Glyphosate 41% SL is a systemic, non-selective post-emergence herbicide in a soluble liquid formulation. It is absorbed through the green parts of the weed and moves down to the roots, helping control a wide range of annual and perennial weeds. Use only as directed on the label and as permitted by regulations.
features:
Active Ingredient: Glyphosate 41% SL
Systemic, Non-Selective Herbicide
Post-Emergence Action Through the Leaves
Moves to the Roots for Thorough Weed Control
Easy-to-Mix Soluble Liquid Formulation
mode: Absorbed through the leaves and carried through the plant, it blocks an enzyme (EPSP synthase) the weed needs to make essential amino acids, which stops growth.

head: Fast-Acting Contact Herbicide for Non-Selective Weed Burndown
desc: Paraquat Dichloride 24% SL is a fast-acting, non-selective contact herbicide in a soluble liquid formulation. It burns down the green tissue it touches. Highly hazardous product: handle strictly as per the label and use only as permitted by regulations.
features:
Active Ingredient: Paraquat Dichloride 24% SL
Non-Selective Contact Herbicide
Quick Burndown of Green Weed Growth
Post-Emergence Action
Easy-to-Mix Soluble Liquid Formulation
mode: Acts on contact with green plant tissue by disrupting photosynthesis, which quickly damages the cells and dries out the foliage.

head: Selective Post-Emergence Herbicide for Grassy Weed Control
desc: Quizalofop Ethyl 10% EC is a selective post-emergence herbicide in an emulsifiable concentrate formulation. It is absorbed by the leaves and moves through the weed, controlling the grassy weeds listed on its label without harming the broad-leaved crops it is registered for.
features:
Active Ingredient: Quizalofop Ethyl 10% EC
Selective Herbicide for Grassy Weeds
Post-Emergence Systemic Action
Easy-to-Mix Liquid Formulation
mode: Absorbed through the leaves and moved through the plant, it blocks the ACCase enzyme that grassy weeds need to make fats for new growth, so the weeds stop growing and die.

head: Growth Regulator for Better Plant Structure and Flowering
desc: Paclobutrazol 23% SC is a plant growth regulator in a suspension concentrate formulation. It slows excessive shoot growth so the plant can put more energy into flowering and fruiting. Use only on the crops and at the stages given on the label.
features:
Active Ingredient: Paclobutrazol 23% SC
Plant Growth Regulator
Controls Excessive Vegetative Growth
Supports Flowering and Fruiting (as per label)
Easy-to-Mix Liquid Suspension
mode: Reduces the plant's own gibberellin production, which slows stem and shoot elongation and helps balance vegetative and reproductive growth.

head: Gibberellic Acid Growth Promoter for Stronger Plant Growth
desc: Gibberellic Acid 0.001% L is a liquid plant growth regulator containing the natural plant hormone gibberellin (GA3). It supports cell elongation and active growth, and can help with germination, flowering and fruit development on the crops listed on the label.

Plant Growth Regulator
Supports Cell Elongation and Active Growth
Helps Flowering and Fruit Development (as per label)
Easy-to-Mix Liquid Formulation

Supports Healthy and Active Plant Growth
Helps Crops Recover from Stress
Suitable for Foliar Application
Easy-to-Mix Formulation

High-Strength Soil Conditioner

Supports Root Development

head: Iron and Sulphur Fertilizer for Greener, Healthier Crops
desc: Nutrizen is a fertilizer that supplies iron (19%) and sulphur (10.5%) in one product. Iron is needed to form chlorophyll and helps correct yellowing of young leaves caused by iron deficiency. Sulphur supports protein and oil formation and healthy growth. Use as directed on the label.

Helps Correct Iron Deficiency (Yellowing of Young Leaves)
Supports Chlorophyll Formation and Green Growth
Sulphur Supports Protein and Oil Formation
